faq.title: Frequently asked questions about 3D maps and keychains
faq.q1: What is a 3D city map and how is it different from a regular map?
faq.a1: A 3D city map is a three-dimensional tactile model of a district with real building heights, parks and rivers from OpenStreetMap data. Unlike a flat map, you can hold it, put it on a shelf or give it as a gift.
faq.q2: Can you make a 3D map of any city in the world?
faq.a2: Yes. In the Monadruk builder you can pick any point on Earth — from Kyiv and Lviv to New York or Paris — and create a 3D map of that district in minutes.
faq.q3: In what format do I get the file for 3D printing?
faq.a3: You download a ready 3MF file (and STL too) — it opens straight away in Bambu Studio or PrusaSlicer and is ready to print at home.
faq.q4: How much does a city map keychain or a 3D map cost?
faq.a4: A city map keychain starts at €7, a 3D district map from €17 for made-to-order printing. If you print yourself, downloading the ready file is free within your limit.
faq.q5: Can I order printing if I don't have a 3D printer?
faq.a5: Yes. We print your 3D map or keychain in eco-friendly Eco PLA bioplastic and ship the finished item.
faq.q6: Can I add my own text to the map keychain?
faq.a6: Yes — on a 55×30 mm map keychain you can add a city name or custom text printed in relief over the district map.
faq.q7: Can I get a keychain with mountain relief instead of streets?
faq.a7: Yes — that's the topo keychain. Switch on the “Terrain relief” mode in the builder and the token is printed with the real elevation relief of the place from satellite height data: the Alps, the Carpathians, fjords or a coastline. Peaks and valleys are readable with your fingers.
faq.q8: Do you ship keychains and maps across Europe?
faq.a8: Yes. We print and ship within Ukraine (Nova Poshta, Ukrposhta) and to 15 EU countries via Nova Post EU and Meest: Poland, Germany, Czechia, Spain, Italy, France and more.
faq.q9: What is a city-map fridge magnet?
faq.a9: A flat 3D-printed magnet of about 60 mm with the map of your neighbourhood: streets, parks and rivers in relief, with a pocket for a neodymium magnet on the back. A budget-friendly personal souvenir of a memorable place.

seo.title: 3D city maps and personalised keychains — what we make
seo.p1: Monadruk turns any place on Earth into a printable 3D model: a 3D map of a city district with real building heights, parks and rivers from OpenStreetMap data, a city map keychain with your own text, a topographic keychain with real mountain relief from satellite elevation data, or a city-map fridge magnet. The 3MF and STL files open straight in Bambu Studio and PrusaSlicer, ready to print at home.
seo.p2: No 3D printer? We print for you in eco-friendly Eco PLA and ship across Ukraine and the EU. A 3D map of London, Berlin, Kyiv or New York, the relief of the Alps or Hoverla, a personalised anniversary keychain — pick a spot on the map and the model is ready in minutes.
